sourceControls.name: discrete_cocompact
sourceControls.signature:
theorem discrete_cocompact : ∀ (F : Type) [Field F] [NumberField F],
    (∃ C : Set (AdeleRing (𝓞 F) F), IsCompact C ∧
      ∀ y, ∃ l : F, y - algebraMap F (AdeleRing (𝓞 F) F) l ∈ C) ∧
    (∀ C : Set (AdeleRing (𝓞 F) F), IsCompact C →
      {l : F | algebraMap F (AdeleRing (𝓞 F) F) l ∈ C}.Finite) ∧
    NoncompactSpace (AdeleRing (𝓞 F) F)
sourceControls.reason: The number field embeds discretely and cocompactly in its adèle ring.

theorem structMap_down (s : BlowupSequence X) {i i' : ℕ} (h : i ≤ i') :

sourceControls.name: ideleClassToCycTateZero_apply
sourceControls.signature:
theorem ideleClassToCycTateZero_apply (σ : Gal(L/K)) (c : Additive (IdeleClassGroup K)) :
    ideleClassToCycTateZero K L σ c = QuotientAddGroup.mk ⟨Additive.ofMul (ideleClassMap K L c.toMul),
      by
        rw [AddMonoidHom.mem_ker, cycSubOne_apply, Representation.ofMulDistribMulAction_apply_apply,
          sub_eq_zero]
        exact congrArg Additive.ofMul (smul_ideleClassMap σ _)⟩
sourceControls.reason: The application formula identifies an idèle class in the cyclic Tate construction.

sourceControls.name: codim_invariants_eq
sourceControls.signature:
theorem codim_invariants_eq (ρ : Representation ℂ H V) :
    ((finrank ℂ V - finrank ℂ (invariants ρ) : ℕ) : ℂ) =
      (Nat.card H : ℂ)⁻¹ * ∑ h : H, (ρ.character 1 - ρ.character h)
sourceControls.reason: The codimension of the invariants of a finite group is expressed as an average of character values.
